2607.11459.title: A Multimodal Dataset for Large Language Model Applications in the Energy Domain
2607.11459.paper_summary: This paper presents the mAIEnergy dataset, an open-access, multimodal corpus developed to support Large Language Model (LLM) applications in the energy sector. The dataset integrates approximately 50,000 textual documents, 20,000 images, 25 million numerical time series records, and 2 million geospatial and relational data entries. It includes policy and regulatory texts, scientific articles and news articles, satellite and contextual imagery, electricity system measurements, weather observations, statistical indicators, and geospatial representations of energy infrastructure and related entities. All data have been harmonized into structured, ready-to-use formats, accompanied by consistent metadata and reproducible data retrieval and preparation workflows. The dataset can serve as a foundational energy knowledge base, allowing energy stakeholders to integrate additional open-source or proprietary data. The mAIEnergy dataset adheres to Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable (FAIR) principles, enhancing its applicability for AI-driven energy research, modeling, and decision-making.
2607.11459.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文介紹了mAIEnergy數據集，這是一個開放訪問的多模態語料庫，旨在支持能源領域的大型語言模型（LLM）應用。<lb/>該數據集整合了約50,000份文本文件、20,000張圖像、2,500萬條數值時間序列記錄，以及200萬條地理空間和關聯數據條目。<lb/>它包括政策和法規文本、科學文章和新聞文章、衛星和背景影像、電力系統測量、氣象觀測、統計指標，以及能源基礎設施和相關實體的地理空間表示。<lb/>所有數據都已經被統一為結構化的、可即用的格式，並附有一致的元數據和可重複的數據檢索與準備工作流程。<lb/>該數據集可以作為一個基礎的能源知識庫，使能源利益相關者能夠整合額外的開源或專有數據。<lb/>mAIEnergy數據集遵循可尋找、可訪問、可互操作和可重用（FAIR）原則，增強了其在AI驅動的能源研究、建模和決策中的適用性。
